body:
Aria W.: Unboxed my MBP (M2) and installed the macOS beta I was testing at home (wanted the new windowing). Now MDM enrollment shows 'Unsupported OS version' and the setup assistant won't finish. FileVault is stuck at 'Encrypting: 0%'. Need to join a 3pm kickoff. Help?

IT Support: Hey Aria, welcome! Beta OS can break MDM profiles and the bootstrap token. First quickq: can you paste output of `sw_vers -productVersion` and `profiles status -type enrollment`? Also, are you on wifi or wired?

Aria W.: ProductVersion: 15.0b2. profiles output: "Enrolled via MDM: No, Profiles: none". On wifi.

Zoe (Onboarding): Heads up we only support stable releases (macOS 14.x) for device enrollment. Two options: (A) revert to supported macOS (reinstall via Apple Configurator DFU) or (B) we can issue a temporary local admin so you can join the call and use a browser until we reprovision. Which do you want?

Aria W.: I need the call now, so temp admin please. I can do the reinstall later with Hardware Ops.

IT Support: OK. Creating a 24h temp admin. Paste this into Terminal as one line: `sudo sysadminctl -addUser temp_aria -fullName "Temp Aria" -password "RdTMP!2026" -admin` Then log out and sign in as temp_aria. Do NOT run any further OS upgrades.

Aria W.: Temp account created and I can join the call. Thanks. FileVault UI still shows 'Encrypting: 0%'.

IT Support: That 0% is expected — without a valid MDM bootstrap token the system might not escrow the recovery key, and the MDM agent will refuse to mark the device as enrolled. We'll hold off on final encryption. For now keep it running as temp_aria. After the meeting we'll coordinate reinstall.

Hardware Ops: I can ship a spare MBP preloaded with macOS 14.6 out today if you'd rather not mess with DFU yourself. ETA same-day in SF bay area. Want me to send one?

Aria W.: If spare is available that'd be awesome, avoids me losing dev time today.

Hardware Ops: Cool, reserve MBP-STD-013 and mark it for Aria. ETA pickup/delivery 3h. We'll reclaim the M2 for DFU later.

DevTools: When you get the replacement, ping me and I'll run the bootstrap token check and push our VPN cert+brew scripts. Also note: if you ever enable FileVault manually before enrollment on Apple Silicon, it might create a personal recovery key that we can't escrow; avoid that unless instructed.

Zoe (Onboarding): Removing temp_aria later today. Aria, once you have the spare or after DFU reinstall we'll re-enroll the M2 into DEP and then enable FileVault; the dialog should say 'Your recovery key will be saved to your organization's management system' when done properly.

Aria W.: Appreciate the help and the spare laptop offer. Joining the kickoff now. :rocket:

onboarding-bot: Device M2-C02ZXY12345 flagged with non-supported OS. Temp account temp_aria created and scheduled for deletion in 24h. Replacement MBP-STD-013 reserved for Aria W. Enrollment pending after reprovision. Welcome to Redwood Inference!
